passwords.note: Six random-looking characters with a lone digit at the end, which is rare rather than unheard of.
Digits-then-letters with a birth-year tail is a pattern many people try, yet this exact combination shows up only occasionally.
Plain plural animal names like "rhinos" pile up in leaked lists because people pick a single easy noun and just add an S.
Hector is a short, plain first name, and people often use names like it as passwords with no added complexity.
Lots of people end a favorite food word with an exclamation mark, so "pizza!" shows up often.
